_readme: Business details used across the whole website. Edit values here, commit, and the site rebuilds automatically. Leave a value empty ("") to hide it. See README.md for the full launch checklist.

brand.name: Veltrix Windows & Doors
brand.tagline: uPVC windows and doors, made to measure and fitted properly.
brand.seoDescription: uPVC windows, composite doors and repairs, made to measure and fitted properly. Free survey, itemised written quote and an online quote builder.
brand.description: Veltrix Windows & Doors supplies, installs and repairs uPVC windows and doors — casement, flush sash, tilt & turn, sash, bay, French, patio, bi-fold and composite doors — with free surveys and written quotes.

chatHours._readme: When the team answers WhatsApp and website chat messages, every day (24-hour times, e.g. 23:59).

forms._readme: Optional. Paste a Formspree or Basin form endpoint URL to receive a copy of every quote and booking by email as well as WhatsApp. Put the provider name in provider (shown in the privacy policy). Send a test enquiry afterwards to confirm the email arrives.

quoteUpload._readme: Optional. Paste the Google Apps Script web app URL (ends in /exec) from DEPLOY.md step 8. Quote PDFs are then saved to your Google Drive and the WhatsApp message carries a link to the PDF, so the customer only presses Send. Leave empty to keep the old way (the customer saves the PDF and attaches it).
